relevance.rationale: JOIN IS ONLY HALF RIGHT, and the key conflates three distinct works. The uploaded PDF is arXiv:math/0007054v4, Seminaire Bourbaki 52eme annee 1999-2000 no. 875, 'Vertex Algebras and Algebraic Curves', by Edward Frenkel ALONE (a survey exposé). The registered frenkel2004 entry is the BOOK of the same title by Frenkel and Ben-Zvi (DOI 10.1090/surv/088), whose URL field however points at math/0007054 - i.e. the entry's own metadata already mixes the book with the Bourbaki survey. Third work in the mix: the citing Lean docstrings at folio/quantum-observable-universe/mass-theory/vertex-operator.lean:39 and categorical-transfer-matrix.lean:57 read '-- Ref: [frenkel2004] Frenkel, "Lectures on the Langlands program and conformal field theory," arXiv:hep-th/0512172 (related: 0007054)' - that is a fourth-and-different Frenkel work (the 2005 Langlands lectures), neither the book nor this upload. Not in the working tree on this branch; recovered from intake commit c27c967c9d, sha matches. Load-bearing assessment: the citation is background only. The Lean structures it annotates (VertexOperator, carrying a ReebBundle and a natural-number weight; OPE, carrying two operators and two Hecke eigenvalues) are QOU-specific scaffolding; nothing from a vertex-algebra source is derived, and the .ts sites (vertex-operator.ts:19, vertex-operator-dictionary.ts:16) are cites arrays. Scope-(a): this document, as read, is standard vertex-algebra background and supplies no result the folio consumes.

proposedActions.rationale: Untangle the key: the registered entry names the Frenkel-Ben-Zvi book but its URL is the single-author Bourbaki survey (this upload), and two Lean docstrings attribute the key to a third work, the hep-th/0512172 Langlands lectures. Decide which work the key denotes, then correct the two Lean docstrings to match.
